name: Kaali crater
description: A meteorite hit Saaremaa around 1500 BC and left a 110m circular lake in what is now a field. It happened while people were living here, which is probably why it turns up in Baltic and Finnish mythology as a sun falling out of the sky.
getting: Ferry from Virtsu to Kuivastu, then about an hour's drive. It is signposted and free, and takes twenty minutes to walk round.
